prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept, finished Chinese philosophy book cover for a digital library, vertical 2:3, flat full bleed front cover only. Exact title “毛泽东选集”, small exact subtitle “第一至四卷”, author “毛泽东”. Museum quality editorial typography: large authentic expressive Chinese brush lettering in warm ivory, carefully spaced scholarly small print. Deep nearly black oxblood cloth, aged paper strata and a restrained topographic mountain contour engraved in dark brass in the lower half, a small red editorial seal shape without text. Material photography and elegant abstract symbolism, serious archival philosophical aesthetic. No illustrated figures, no cartoon, no propaganda poster, no glossy 3D book mockup, no extra words. Preserve generous margins and readable title.
